title: Cost Optimization
subtitle: Idle reports worker
description: A batch worker has been running four instances with no traffic for hours. The agent should find it, confirm it is idle, non-critical and healthy, and stop it.
prompt: Review the current services and reduce unnecessary cost without breaking the latency or availability requirements.

expected.outcome: Action executed and verified. Savings released.

title: Rising Traffic
subtitle: Orders traffic doubled
description: Traffic on the orders API has doubled in one window and latency is climbing toward its target. The agent should add capacity before the target is breached.
prompt: Orders traffic is increasing. Keep the service within its latency target.

expected.outcome: Capacity increased to 5 instances and verified below the latency target.

title: Stale Observation
subtitle: Old metrics conflict with latest traffic
description: The stored observation for the checkout API is over two hours old and shows light traffic, while the live traffic feed shows a heavy load. The agent must refuse to optimize on stale data.
prompt: Reduce cost if it is safe.

expected.outcome: Scale-down blocked on stale data, observation refreshed, then re-evaluated safely.

title: Failed Action
subtitle: Scale operation rejected by cloud capacity
description: The payment API is saturated and needs capacity, but the simulated cloud region cannot allocate the requested instances. The agent must report the failure honestly.
prompt: Scale the payment service only if the current state requires it.

expected.outcome: Cloud rejected the request with capacity_unavailable. Service remains under pressure.
